LLMClinicalInsights.Summary:
The machine learning experiments identified RandomForest as the best predictive model with an accuracy of 0.44. This model can be used to support predictive healthcare analytics such as patient risk prediction and treatment outcome forecasting.
Cluster analysis revealed 3 distinct patient groups, highlighting heterogeneity in patient demographics, healthcare utilization, and medical conditions.
Combining machine learning predictions with cluster-based patient segmentation enables explainable healthcare analytics and supports data-driven clinical decisions.
